I'm a data scientist born in the London and based in Tokyo, always on the lookout for
easy AI wins that most people overlook.

With the invention of the Transformer and its heralding in of the new AI Summer,
everyone is looking at how LLMs and other frontier models can solve new and
interesting problems, but often that outlook leaves behind problems that have been
waiting for solutions for years, decades, or even longer; closing these gaps is the
name of my game.
